name: Kodomo no Himitsu
source: Kirara and Chinatsu are best friends together in the 5th grade. One day they discover an adult book after school. In it they read about masturbation but they don't understand it. Kirara decides to ask her teacher for an example . . .
translation: 琪拉拉和千夏是五年级最好的朋友。有一天，他们放学后发现一本成人书。他们在书中读到了有关手淫的内容，但他们并不理解。基拉拉决定向她的老师询问一个例子。。。
